interface.shortDescription: Screen stocks and read cached AI company reports.
interface.longDescription: Stock Data Desk provides stock screening, historical comparison, read-only SQL, cached English AI company reports with PDFs, and temporary CSV exports across Work, ChatGPT, and Codex. The private Developer Mode App currently uses anonymous development access; hosted OAuth and per-user approval remain prepared for a later activation.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the latest cached AI company report for ASX BGL and include its PDF.
Find the strongest momentum stocks in the latest data.
Compare unusual volume across supported exchanges.
